passage:
The city added electric vehicle charging stations on public streets. Electric car owners were pleased, but some residents complained that parking spaces had become limited.
City officials explained that transportation was changing, but they also needed fair access. They placed stations in different neighborhoods, not only wealthy areas.
Students studied the issue as part of a civics project.
They learned that green technology can still raise fairness questions. Who gets the benefit first? Who pays? Who loses space?
A charging station may look like a simple machine. In public planning, it is also a decision about the future city.
